ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio (~2:1) between low-intensity black pixels in the central and medial regions and high-intensity white pixels on the lateral lobe margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black region occupying the central 60% of the visible fluke surface. High-intensity white mottling concentrated on the outer 20% of both lateral lobes. Two distinct low-intensity elliptical blobs observed within the high-intensity white field of the right lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate aperture of 130 degrees and a depth of approximately 5% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular saw-tooth profile along the trailing edge featuring multiple high-frequency peaks and a notable macroscopic indentation located on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature on the superior boundaries, tapering to sharp lateral vertices at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density white pixel speckling observed on the lower central region of the left lobe and scattered across the primary dark central body.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel vertical high-intensity linear features (rake marks) on the mid-left lobe spanning approximately 15% of the local height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Reddish-brown discoloration and irregular tissue loss at the distal vertex of the left lobe. Deep irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Two prominent dark circular spots localized in the upper-right white region of the right fluke lobe.
